name: Asami Aoki
source:
"Has been a loyal maid of Anne for over 7 years. She keeps both the house clean and stocked with food as her duties include preparing meals as well as servicing Anne herself when the need arises.
Asami loves her job and is totally committed to be treated more as a servant than a maid."
